How the two options work

1. Open official source: the movie opens in its authorised website or app.

2. Play inside CineNova: only for a video whose provider permits embedding. This demo does not yet automatically find embeddable streams or verify licensing for each title.

Never assume a movie is free just because it is online. Check the rights and terms for each item. CineNova does not host pirated movies.

About CineNova AI

Beta 9 — Premium Discover ✦

Mobile-friendly movie discovery demo with search, genre filters, title detail cards, local watchlist, simple personalized recommendations, legal source links, external official-site playback options, and local video playback.

Important: commercial movie streams are not included automatically. A title can play inside this app only when its official provider permits embedding; otherwise it opens in the provider's website/app. This demo has no licensed streaming catalogue, real cloud AI, accounts, or cloud sync.
